compare-specific-page-range-pdf.title: Compare Selected Page Range of Two PDFs
compare-specific-page-range-pdf.description: Demonstrates how to load two PDF documents, define a start and end page, and compare only that page range using Aspose.Pdf's comparison API.

compare-pdf-documents-page-by-page-diff.title: Compare PDFs Page by Page and Generate a Diff PDF
compare-pdf-documents-page-by-page-diff.description: Shows how to compare two PDF files page by page by extracting their text and creating a new PDF that lists the differing pages and their contents.

compare-selected-pdf-pages-side-by-side.title: Compare Selected PDF Pages with Aspose.Pdf
compare-selected-pdf-pages-side-by-side.description: Demonstrates how to compare specific pages of two PDF documents by passing a page list to the Aspose.Pdf comparison API and retrieve per‑page differences.

exclude-areas-from-pdf-comparison.title: Exclude Areas in Side‑by‑Side PDF Comparison
exclude-areas-from-pdf-comparison.description: Demonstrates how to exclude specific rectangular regions from both PDFs using the ExcludedAreasFirstDocument and ExcludedAreasSecondDocument properties before performing a side‑by‑side visual comparison.

exclude-annotations-from-pdf-comparison.title: Exclude Annotations from PDF Comparison
exclude-annotations-from-pdf-comparison.description: Shows how to gather annotation bounding rectangles from two PDFs and set them as excluded areas in a side‑by‑side comparison using Aspose.Pdf.

exclude-footer-areas-in-pdf-comparison.title: Compare PDFs While Excluding Footer Regions
exclude-footer-areas-in-pdf-comparison.description: Demonstrates how to define a rectangular footer area and add it to the ExcludeAreas collections of SideBySideComparisonOptions to ignore footers during a side‑by‑side PDF comparison.

compare-two-pdfs-aspdf-comparison.title: Case‑Insensitive PDF Text Comparison
compare-two-pdfs-aspdf-comparison.description: Demonstrates extracting text from two PDF documents page‑by‑page with Aspose.Pdf and comparing the strings while ignoring case differences.

set-custom-image-similarity-tolerance-pd.title: Set Custom Image Similarity Tolerance for PDF Comparison
set-custom-image-similarity-tolerance-pd.description: Demonstrates how to configure a custom image similarity tolerance using GraphicalPdfComparer when comparing PDFs that contain scanned images, and saves the visual comparison result.

compare-pdfs-with-form-fields.title: Compare PDFs with Form Field Values Using Side‑by‑Side Comparison
compare-pdfs-with-form-fields.description: Loads two PDF documents and performs a visual side‑by‑side comparison that includes form field values, generating a diff PDF.

compare-pdfs-different-page-sizes.title: Compare PDFs with Different Page Sizes Side‑by‑Side
compare-pdfs-different-page-sizes.description: Demonstrates how to perform a side‑by‑side visual comparison of two PDFs that have different page dimensions and verify the resulting combined page sizes.

compare-pdf-text-ignoring-compression.title: Compare PDF Text Content with Different Compression Settings
compare-pdf-text-ignoring-compression.description: Demonstrates extracting pure text from two PDFs using Aspose.Pdf and comparing the strings to verify that compression differences do not affect textual content.

compare-pdfs-unicode-text-differences.title: Unicode PDF Text Comparison
compare-pdfs-unicode-text-differences.description: Extracts Unicode text from two PDF files using Aspose.Pdf and compares the strings to detect the first character difference, handling different language encodings.

compare-pdfs-detect-font-differences.title: Compare Embedded Fonts Between PDFs
compare-pdfs-detect-font-differences.description: Loads two PDF files, iterates through each page, extracts font information, and reports differences in font presence and embedding status.

compare-encrypted-pdfs-side-by-side.title: Compare Encrypted PDFs with Text and Visual Differences
compare-encrypted-pdfs-side-by-side.description: Demonstrates opening password‑protected PDF files and comparing them both textually and side‑by‑side visually using Aspose.Pdf.

generate-visual-diff-pdf.title: Create Visual PDF Diff with GraphicalPdfComparer
generate-visual-diff-pdf.description: Demonstrates how to generate a visual difference PDF by loading two documents and using Aspose.Pdf's GraphicalPdfComparer to produce a diff file.

get-image-differences-between-pdf-pages.title: Compare Images Between Two PDF Documents
get-image-differences-between-pdf-pages.description: Loads two PDF files, iterates through their pages, extracts embedded images, and reports differences based on missing images or differing byte content.

generate-diff-pdf-by-comparing-two-pdfs.title: Create Diff PDF with Text Stamp Using CompareDocumentsToPdf
generate-diff-pdf-by-comparing-two-pdfs.description: Demonstrates how to generate a diff PDF by copying the modified document, adding a text stamp annotation to highlight the comparison, and saving the result to a specified folder.

generate-diff-pdf-highlighted-text-chang.title: Create Side‑by‑Side PDF Diff and Verify Highlight Colors
generate-diff-pdf-highlighted-text-chang.description: The example compares two PDF files side‑by‑side, generates a diff PDF with default highlight colors for added and deleted text, and then checks that the highlight annotations use the expected colors.

compare-pdfs-generate-json-diff-report.title: Generate JSON Diff Report for PDF Comparison
compare-pdfs-generate-json-diff-report.description: Shows how to compare two PDF files with Aspose.Pdf's TextPdfComparer, collect DiffOperation objects, and serialize the differences into a readable JSON report.

replace-text-using-diffoperation.title: Replace Modified PDF Text with Original Content
replace-text-using-diffoperation.description: Compares two PDFs page‑by‑page, extracts their text, and replaces any differing page content in the target PDF with the original PDF's text while preserving basic styling.

compare-pdfs-log-differences.title: Compare Two PDFs and Log Differences by Page
compare-pdfs-log-differences.description: Demonstrates how to compare two PDF documents page‑by‑page using Aspose.Pdf and write each difference’s operation type and page number to a log file for audit purposes.

compare-two-pdfs-visual-diff.title: Side-by-Side PDF Comparison with Aspose.Pdf
compare-two-pdfs-visual-diff.description: Demonstrates how to compare two PDF files visually using Aspose.Pdf's side‑by‑side comparison feature and save the result as a new PDF.

preserve-original-metadata-in-diff-pdf.title: Preserve PDF Metadata After Side‑by‑Side Comparison
preserve-original-metadata-in-diff-pdf.description: Demonstrates how to compare two PDFs using Aspose.Pdf's side‑by‑side comparer, generate a diff PDF, and copy all standard and custom metadata from the source PDF to the diff PDF.

multi-threaded-pdf-comparison.title: Multi‑threaded PDF Comparison with Aspose.Pdf
multi-threaded-pdf-comparison.description: Demonstrates how to compare two PDF files page‑by‑page using Aspose.Pdf, extracting text with TextAbsorber and running each comparison in a separate task to collect results concurrently.

batch-pdf-comparison-parallel.title: Batch PDF Comparison with Parallel Processing
batch-pdf-comparison-parallel.description: Shows how to compare a reference PDF against multiple PDFs in a folder by checking page count and full text content, using Aspose.Pdf and parallel processing with limited concurrency.

generate-pdf-diff-images-zip.title: Create PDF Comparison Diff Images and Package into ZIP
generate-pdf-diff-images-zip.description: Demonstrates how to compare two PDFs side‑by‑side using Aspose.Pdf, convert each comparison page to PNG images, and bundle the images into a ZIP archive for easy distribution.
